Definition: from a derivative of a primary ῥέπω (to let fall, "rap"); to slap:--smite (with the palm of the hand). Compare G5180.
BiblicalUsage: Whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also, and in the high priest's house they spat in His face and buffeted Him.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the cheek turned is stronger than the hand that strikes, because it refuses to answer evil with evil.
RelatedEvents: The Sermon on the Mount; The Crucifixion
